card.name: Small words in all-caps warning text
card.fires_on: Short linking words or word endings (FOR, THE, WITH, WHEN, BE, -EST, -S) inside all-caps boxed warning or indication sentences. It fires where a word like 'initial' or 'only' could plausibly come next.

modes.label: Linking words after INDICATED
modes.description: Small words like FOR or THE right after 'IS INDICATED' in all-caps warnings.
modes.example: CIDOFOVIR INJECTION IS INDICATED ONLY FOR<< THE>> TREATMENT OF CMV RETINIT

modes.label: Word endings in caps
modes.description: Partway through capitalized words such as LOW-EST or PATIENT-S in warning sentences.
modes.example: IT IS RECOMMENDED THAT THE LOW<<EST>> EFFECTIVE DOSE OF PROMETHAZ

modes.label: Other small words
modes.description: Words like WITH, WHEN or BE in all-caps warnings about patients or prescribing.
modes.example: FELBAMATE ORAL SUSPENSION SHOULD NOT<< BE>> PRESCRIBED FOR ANYONE WITH

card.writes: It pushes the model toward 'initial' and 'initially' as the next word, as in initial dose or initial treatment.
card.plain: It lights up on small connecting words in all-caps boxed warnings, where a word like 'initial' might come next.
